name: pad

source.prompt: One low heavy portable industrial rocket launch platform, a single small aesthetic diecast launch pedestal made of porcelain-white metal and brushed-steel components. Horizontal wide structure, square plinth, circular recessed gray launch socket at center of the upper plane; view looking down 15 degrees at its front and right edges. No rocket, tower, pipes, exhaust, labels or terrain. Photoreal product photography.

method: Use aligned region mask and original neutral luminance. Model used neutral top-left light. Diffuse = min(1,1.2*luma^0.74), specular shoulder above .80, preserve original alpha and unmasked pixels. Region construction is recorded in palette.ts.
